name: dropbox
description: The Dropbox plugin for Cursor connects your Dropbox files directly to Cursor, so you can search, reference, and organize files, save generated content, and create sharing links - all without switching tools. It respects your existing Dropbox permissions, and Cursor only works with files you already have access to.

skills.name: clean-up-dropbox-content
skills.description: Clean up Dropbox content by identifying obsolete, duplicate, temporary, or unwanted files and deleting only after explicit review. Use when the user explicitly asks to delete, remove, or clean up Dropbox files or folders.

skills.name: collect-files-with-request
skills.description: Create, inspect, and manage Dropbox file requests for collecting uploads from other people. Use when the user asks to collect files, request uploads, create an upload portal, check a file request, or list existing file requests.

skills.name: find-dropbox-content
skills.description: Find Dropbox files and folders relevant to a user request. Use when the user asks to search Dropbox, find a document, locate recent files, browse a folder, identify likely source files, or narrow down where content lives before reading, sharing, organizing, or restoring it.

skills.name: inspect-dropbox-file
skills.description: Inspect a Dropbox file or folder by checking metadata, shared links, and file content when needed. Use when the user asks what a file is, whether it is shared, when it changed, what access links exist, or asks to read/analyze a Dropbox file.

skills.name: organize-dropbox-folder
skills.description: Organize Dropbox files and folders by creating folders, copying content, or moving content into a cleaner structure. Use when the user asks to organize, archive, consolidate, restructure, copy, or move Dropbox content.

skills.name: share-dropbox-content
skills.description: Share Dropbox files or folders by creating shared links, inspecting existing shared links, or explaining current shared-link state. Use only when the user explicitly asks to create a shared link, check access, or inspect a Dropbox shared link.
